offering_description.value: Underwrites specialty property and casualty insurance for hard-to-place and catastrophe-exposed risks, sold to homeowners and businesses through independent agents and wholesale brokers. It earns premiums from policies it underwrites and manages risk through reinsurance.

primary_products.value: residential earthquake insurance; inland marine insurance; excess and surplus property insurance; commercial property insurance; crop insurance

customer_segment.value: B2C: homeowners buying residential earthquake coverage; B2B: commercial property owners, contractors, agribusinesses, and specialty risk buyers

end_markets.value: property insurance; agriculture; construction; real estate; transportation

revenue_model.value: interest or premiums: earned premiums on insurance policies, plus investment income on reserves; commissions or management fees: fees from program and managing general agent arrangements
revenue_model.category: interest or premiums; commissions or management fees

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: takes in premiums and pays claims, selling policies to homeowners and businesses; service provider: underwriting and claims administration for policies it places through agents and programs

geography_served.value: US national: nationwide, with the largest exposure in California and other earthquake-prone and catastrophe-exposed states

specialization.value: related lines: property and catastrophe-exposed lines sharing underwriting, reinsurance and distribution: earthquake, inland marine, excess and surplus, crop

distribution_channels.value: agents / brokers: independent insurance agents and wholesale brokers; partners / resellers: managing general agents and program administrators

regulatory_exposure.value: high: insurance licensing and rate and form approval by state insurance departments, surplus lines and reinsurance rules

notes: Product lines and channel mix are from general knowledge and may have shifted; verify current lines and any recent acquisitions.
